answer: Same setup as your last long train stretch, so I'd reach for the same toolkit: a few of the light Stuff You Should Know episodes (bubble gum, vending machines, amusement parks) when you're half-listening, and Alto's Odyssey for when you'd rather not listen to anything. For comfort, get up once an hour and run through a couple of the shoulder rolls, cat-cow, and hip flexor stretches from your routine, and keep water within reach. If you want the time to feel productive, three hours is ideal for sketching out the April Seoul trip - picking which Seoul City Walking Tour courses to prioritize, and downloading Naver Maps and any offline maps before the signal drops.
